# Levente Varga

> Portfolio of Levente Varga, freelance software developer and entrepreneur from Debrecen, Hungary. IT engineering student at the University of Debrecen. Works mainly with Node.js and React, builds CI/CD pipelines and runs containerized infrastructure with Docker and Podman.

Languages: Java, C#, Python, PHP, JavaScript. Security and stability are top priorities.

## Pages

- [Home](https://varga-levente.com/): Introduction and social links
- [About](https://varga-levente.com/about): Background, skills, tech stack, tools and GitHub activity
- [Projects](https://varga-levente.com/project): Selected projects with source code and demo links
- [Resume](https://varga-levente.com/resume): Education, experience and skills, downloadable as PDF

## Projects

- [Cinema React/Java Spring App](https://github.com/Varga-Levente/Szoftverfejlesztes-mernokoknek): Movie ticket and snack ordering site with seat selection (React, Java Spring, MySQL)
- [GTA:V Roleplay Gym Website](https://github.com/Varga-Levente/NFGym-Website): Sales and attendance logging for a roleplay server gym (PHP, MySQL, Bootstrap)
- [RoBOT Android App](https://github.com/Varga-Levente/RoBOT-Controller-Android-APP): Android app controlling an ESP32 robot over TCP/IP (Android, Java, ESP32)
- [1-Bit BMP Graph Generator](https://github.com/Varga-Levente/rendszerkozeli-programozas-projekt): C program generating 1-bit BMP graphs with IPC (C, Networking)
- [Real Time Chat Application](https://github.com/Varga-Levente/Tavkozlohalo-Chat): Chat client, server and Python validation API with file transfer (C#, Python, TCP/IP)
- [Education Page](https://edu.vlevente.me/): Framework-free PHP site with university course notes
- [Panda3D](https://panda3d.hu/): 3D printing business: custom prints and prototyping
- [PandaSoft](https://pandasoft.hu/): Software development business: custom software, web development, IT consulting
